english: And surely the Hereafter is better for you than the first.

arabic: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ ﴿24﴾
english: So he watered their flocks for them, then turned back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ ﴿62﴾
english: He said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
